test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

When was the money transferred to you by her?

options.text: When does she transfer the money to you?
When did she transferred the money to you?
When did she transfer the money to you?
When was she transferring the money to you?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is a "Wh-" question in the passive voice: "When was the money transferred to you by her?"
 
• The sentence is in the **Simple Past Tense** (was/were + V3).
 
• To convert a Simple Past interrogative sentence from passive to active voice: 
 
 
• The agent "her" becomes the subject "she."
 
• The structure for a Simple Past active question is: **Wh-word + did + subject + base form of verb (V1) + object?**
 
• "Was transferred" changes to "did transfer."
 
• The receiver "the money" becomes the direct object.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When did she transfer the money to you?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"When does she transfer the money to you?" – Incorrect tense (Simple Present).
 
• **Option 2: **"When did she transferred the money to you?" – Grammatically incorrect; "did" must be followed by the base form "transfer," not "transferred."
 
• **Option 4: **"When was she transferring the money to you?" – Incorrect tense (Past Continuous).
